summary: First full test of PT. Prima Agro Tech rebuild. All backend endpoints (POST /api/contact, POST /api/testimonials, GET /api/testimonials, GET /api/testimonials?approved_only=true) pass with data assertions (7/7 pytest). Frontend: home hero + kinetic stats (2008/120+/16+/15,000+) + 5 certification chips + 3 solution cards + discovery teaser + testimonial carousel + WhatsApp fab all render. Solutions hub lists all 7 products; search filters correctly; product detail (/products/biotracol) shows formulation/application/trial/certifications/related + product-whatsapp CTA. Category page /solutions/bio-fertilizers renders 2 correct products. Contact form and Testimonials form both submit successfully with thanks toast. Language toggle switches EN<->ID. Navbar Solutions dropdown works and lists category links. About/OurSciences/Facilities/Sustainability/Career all render.

issues: DecoPrima card description text appears slightly low-contrast (light gray on white card with dark image overlay) — verify against WCAG AA. Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses `os.environ['MONGO_URL']` at import — fails fast if unset (good).
GET /api/testimonials excludes _id via projection (good, no ObjectId serialization risk).
Email send is best-effort (returns True/False) and does not fail the POST — matches spec.
No pagination on GET /api/testimonials (hard-capped to 200) — acceptable for MVP.
Consider adding a minimal length validator on ContactCreate.message and TestimonialCreate.quote to prevent empty spam submissions.
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST_-prefixed contacts and one TEST_Farmer testimonial via API tests; approved=false so not shown on public site.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (7 tests, all pass). Frontend uses lenis + framer-motion — always wait ~2s after navigation for reveal. All requested data-testid attributes exist (lang-toggle, whatsapp-fab, product-whatsapp, contact-name/email/message/submit, testimonial-name/quote/submit). Clear-filters button in Solutions only renders when a filter is active (didn't verify empty-state copy).
